      **Why it matters:** Users mention crashes or instability. Treat as actionable only when volume spikes or follows an update; otherwise it is often baseline noise.

         **Review examples:**
            1. _Victor Starenky_, Aug 8, 2026, 1/5: "The update made the app unusable. This is exactly the wrong way to use AI. instead of making things easier for the user it made it harder. What was a simple easy to add purchases to the portfolio in a tap now requires using a chat that gets it wrong half the time. and I have zero way to confirm what it is doing. I also can't see the total of all my portfolios on the mobile app, this only shows in the desktop version and even then only when I click Lists. Clean simple tool is now a total mess"
            2. _David Gregor_, Aug 3, 2026, 1/5: "This new version is extremely buggy. My list could not be loaded even if I am logged in. Moreover, it crashes regularly on my phone."
            3. _Alejandro Garcia C._, Aug 3, 2026, 1/5: "Since they rolled out the beta version to production, this app and the web browser access are useless. Pure AI slop, unusable. The app was very useful before, please roll back these changes. It makes no sense that you need to use AI to EDIT anything, as AI does it wrong most of the time. Time to move to other solutions until they really test the trash they rolled in."
